missing_still.why: DELETE /documents requires a JSON body of documentIds, and DELETE requests must stay body-less.
Browsing by dataset and time is GET /documents, while a filename or document ID query is GET /documents/search, so the tool selects more than one route.
One job is GET /job/{job_id} and a filtered list is GET /jobs, so the tool selects more than one route when job_id is omitted.
Plan and credits are GET /account, while job counts, credits by type, and daily usage are GET /jobs/summary, so the tool needs more than one route.
POST /document submits base64 file bytes or a caller-supplied remote file URL, and document bytes and free-form URLs stay out of scope.

notes: Live https://docs.composio.dev/toolkits/docupipe lists 13 tools. Index count is 13. Eight tools are one HTTPS JSON route on https://app.docupipe.ai with X-API-Key. Five tools are missing_still. missing_http is empty. 8 mapped + 5 missing_still = 13.
